open(p,'w').write('''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0, 1)]
    color = g[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    sh = max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw = max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
''')

old=open(p).read(); new='''def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    sh = max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw = max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(new)
